title: Post-T02 Masterplan & Execution-Lineage Rebaseline
principle: Execution-system milestones support and record the master development chronology; they do not replace or reorder it.
durable_rules: T02-T06 are frozen post-T02 development lineage.
Post-T07 P01-P06 is a separate controlled GLB track.
The E-series is an execution-system overlay and cannot outrun product-development authority.
The T01/T02 browser-verification mechanism is the proven default browser execution baseline.
A later E milestone does not authorize reopening an earlier product gate or changing physical authority.
